m: चष् cl. 1. ˚षति, to hurt, Vop. (Dhātup. xvii, 43); P. and Ā. to eat, Dhātup. xxi, 24.
a: चष् — {vI.v} {c1c} U. (चषति ते) To eat. {vII.v} {c1c} P. (चषति) To kill, injure, hurt.

s: puM, (cazyate vaDyate'smin । caza + “sAnasivarRasIti .” uRAM । 4 । 107 । iti Ala pratyayena nipAtanAt sADuH .) yUpakawakaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 7 । 18 ॥ yajYasamAptisUcakaM paSubanDanAdyarTaM yajYaBUmO yat kAzWamAropyate sa yUpaH tasya Sirasi valayAkftirqamarukAkftirvvA yaH kAzWavikAraH saH । yUpamUlevihitalohavalayaSca । iti kecit । iti BarataH ॥ maDusTAnam । iti saMkziptasAre uRAdivfttiH ॥
v: pu॰ na॰ caza--Alac ardDarccAdi । yUpakawake yajYiyapaSubanDanArTe yUpamaDyedeye balayAkAre kAzWamaye lOhamaye vA padArTe amaraH । tallakzaRAdikamuktaM kA॰ SrO॰ 6 । 1 । 28 । sUtrAdO “agrAccazAlaM pfTamAtramazwASri maDyasaMgfhItam” 28 sU॰ “yUpa parivAsanAnantaraM yadavaSizwaM pfTakkftamagram tataScazAlaM karttavyam prasAritANguliH pARirAmaRivanDanAn pfTak ityucyate cazAlamiti saMjYA saM vyavahArArTA “A cazAlekzaRAt” ityAdO । azwASri azwakoRam tadapi takzaRenAzwakoRaM kuryyAt takzEva । ulUKalavanmaDye saMkucitam” karkaH । “UrdDamagre pratimuYcati” 29 sU॰ “taccazAlaM yUpasyAgre UrdDvaM pratimuYcati ataevordDapratimokaviDAnAccazAlasya taTA beDaH kAryaH । pratimuYcatIti vacanAcca cUqAgro yUpaH cazAlaM ca sasuziramiti gamyata iti harisvAminaH taTA cAhApastambaH “mUlato'tazwamuparam azwASriranu pUrvo'grato'RIyAn prajYAtAzwASririti” karka॰ “dvyaNgulaM tryaNgulaM vAM tardmAtikrAntaM yUpasya” 30 sU॰ “yUpasya yUpAgrasya dvyaNgulaM tryaNgulaM vA cazAlaM tardmAtikrAntaM cazAlacCidrAgraveDAdatikrAntaM Bavati atikramyordDvaM niHsftaM Bavati taTA cazAlasyordDaM pravayaRaM karttavyam yaTA cazAlo yUpAgrAdaDo dvyaNgule tryaNgule vA tizWatItyarTaH” karkaH “BUScazAlatulitANgulIyakam” mAGaH
m: चषाल m. n. (g. अर्धर्चादि) a wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post, RV. i, 162, 6; TS. vi; Kāṭh. xxvi, 4 (चशाल), ŚBr. &c.
चषाल n. the snout of a hog, MaitrS. i, 6, 3.
a: चषालः — 1 A wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post. --2 An iron ring at the base of that post. --3 A hive.

k.v: वेदिः परिष्कृता भुमिः समे स्थण्डिलचत्वरे। चषालो यूपकटकः कुम्बा सुगहना वृतिः॥

m: चषाल—मुख m. N. of an Ekāha, ŚāṅkhŚr. xiv, 73, 3.
चषाल—वत् (˚षाल-) mfn. furnished with a wooden ring at the top, RV. iii, 8, 10.
चषाल—यूप m. a sacrificial post furnished with a wooden ring at the top, BhP. iv, 19, 19.

s: vaDe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAM-paraM-sakaMsew .) cazati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
Ya Bakze । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAM-uBaMsakaM-sew .) Ya, cazati cazate । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: Bakze BvA॰ uBa॰ saka॰ sew । cazati te acazIt acAzIt acazizwa cacAza cezatuH ceze ।
baDe BvA॰ pa॰ saka॰ sew । cazati aca--(cA)zIt ।

m: चषकाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become a cup, Nalac.

s: puM, klI, (cazati Bakzayati pibatyanenetyarTaH । caza + “kvun SilpisaMjYayorapUrvvasyApi .” uRAM । 2 । 32 । iti kvun .) madyapAnapAtram । tatparyyAyaH । galvarkaH 2 sarakaH 3 anutarzaRam 4 । iti hemacandraH । 4 । 1024 ॥ * ॥ aTa cazakoddeSaH । “yat pAnapAtraM BUpAnAM tajjYeyaM cazakaM buDEH । kAnakaM rAjataYcEva sPAwikaM kAcameva ca ॥ vfttaM svarAzwadikkoRaM caturRAM pfTivIBujAm । ityanyasammataM tezAM nirRayaH pAWasammataH ॥ svamuzwisammitaM ratnEScaturvvarREH samanvitam । mArttikaM vATa PAlaM vA sarvvezAmupayujyate ॥ kAzWajaM DAtujaM SElaM jANgalAdi mahIBujAm । yadanyattoyapAnAdi pAtraM pfTvIBujAM Bavet ॥” evaM tatrApi niyama iti Bojasya niScayaH । iti yuktikalpataruH ॥ * ॥ surApAtram । maDu । madyapraBedaH । iti medinI । ke, 86 ॥
v: pu॰ na॰ caza--karaRe kvun ardDarcAdi । 1 madyapAnapAtre amaraH । tallakzaRAdikaM yuktikalyatarAvuktam yaTA “yat pAnapAtraM BUpAnAM tajjYeyaM cazakaM buDeH । kAnakaM rAjataM cEva sPAwikaM kAcameva ca । vfttaM svarAzwadikvaM ca caturRAM pfTivIBujAm । ityanyasammataM tezAM nirRayaH pAWasammataH । svamuzwisammitaM ratnEScaturvarREH samanvitam । mArttikaM vATa PAlaM vA sarvezAmupayujyate । kAzWajaM DAtujaM SElaM jANgalAdimahIBujAm । yadanyattoyapAnAdipAtraM pfyvIBujAM Bavet । evaM tatrApi niyama iti Bojasya sammataH” “AnanEH parihftaM cazakAntaH” mAGaH । karmaRi kvun । 2 maDuni, 3 madyaBede ca na॰ medi॰
m: चषक m. n. (g. अर्धर्चादि) a cup, wineglass, Ragh. vii, 46; Hcar. viii; Śiś. x &c. (ifc. f(आ). , Kathās. xxi, 10)
चषक m. a second Sch. on VarBṛ. vii, 1 and 12 and xxiv.
a: चषकः --कं — [चष्-करणे क्वुन्] A vessel used for drinking spirits, a goblet, a wine-glass; च्युतैः शिरस्त्रैश्चषकोत्तरेव R. 7. 49; मुखं लालाक्लिन्नं पिबति चषकं सासवमिव Śānti. 1. 29; Ki. 9. 56, 57; Māl. 5. 18. --कं 1 A kind of spirituous liquor. --2 Honey.

k.v: चषकोऽस्त्री पानपात्रं सरकोऽप्यनुतर्षणम्. धूर्तोऽक्षदेवी कितवोऽक्षधूर्तो द्यूतकृत्समाः॥

s: puM, (caza Bakze vaDe vA + BAve atiH .) BakzaRam । vaDaH । iti sidDAntakOmudyAmuRAdivfttiH ॥
v: pu॰ caza--Bakze baDe vA BAve ati । 1 Bakze 2 baDe ca si॰ kO॰ ।
a: चषतिः — [चष्-भावे अति] 1 Eating. --2 Killing. --3 Decay, infirmity, decline.
